input: Apply for a travel rewards credit card

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a travel rewards credit card
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a travel rewards credit card that suits their spending habits and travel goals.

questions.title: Which specific card are you targeting, if any?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has a specific card in mind or needs help choosing one.

questions.title: What is your current credit score range?
questions.description: Understand the user's credit standing to assess eligibility for premium travel cards.

questions.title: How much do you typically spend per month on the card?
questions.description: Monthly spend affects which sign-up bonus or rewards tier makes the most sense.

questions.title: What type of travel do you primarily use rewards for?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user prioritizes flights, hotels, car rentals, or a mix.

questions.title: Do you prefer one airline or hotel loyalty program?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants a co-branded card tied to a specific loyalty program or a flexible points card.

questions.title: What annual fee range are you comfortable paying?
questions.description: Establish budget tolerance for annual fees, ranging from no-fee to premium cards above $500/year.

questions.title: Is there a specific application deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Check if the user has a time constraint such as an upcoming trip or a limited-time sign-up bonus.
